title: Hoja de Referencia de Dibujo de Figura: 16 Poses No Convencionales para Estudiantes de Arte
prompt: A seamless 4x4 reference sheet displaying 16 distinct figure drawing poses of the same adult model, arranged in four rows and four columns with no borders, no frames, no dividing lines, and no gaps between images. Each pose occupies an equal rectangular area within the composition. Full figure visible in each pose. This is a flat composite image, not a physical installation or framed artwork. SUBJECT: Adult model with naturally athletic European build wearing minimal black athletic wear (fitted shorts and sports bra or brief-style bottoms). Natural unstyled appearance with visible pores, subtle skin texture variations, and authentic asymmetry of a real human body. No idealization or airbrushing. Real person physique with natural weight distribution, authentic muscle tone typical of Northern European or Scandinavian body types, genuine skin elasticity. BACKGROUND: Professional photography studio seamless paper backdrop in warm white or light neutral tone. Clean infinity curve with no visible edges, seams, or horizon line. No props, no furniture, no environmental elements - pure white studio void. LIGHTING: Professional studio lighting that sculpts and defines human anatomy - revealing muscle structure, bone landmarks, and three-dimensional form. Soft key light with gentle fill to maintain clear definition of planes and contours without harsh shadows. POSES: Unconventional, non-classical, out-of-distribution poses only. Awkward transitional moments, unstable positions, unusual weight shifts, off-balance stances, mid-movement freezes, unexpected crouches, strange reaching angles, twisted torsos, collapsed shapes, caught-in-between gestures. Bodies doing real things - tying a shoe, catching balance mid-stumble, getting up from floor mid-motion, awkward stretches, looking behind while body turns, stumbling recovery poses, reaching for something overhead while bending sideways, scratching back of neck while leaning, adjusting clothing while standing on one leg. No traditional art school poses. No contrapposto, no classical reclining, no standard seated museum poses. Every pose should feel like a candid freeze-frame of an unposed moment that challenges art students to observe carefully and understand real body mechanics. TECHNICAL: Hyper-realistic documentary photograph captured with a Sony A7R V and 50mm prime lens, tack-sharp clinical focus throughout showing every skin detail. Extreme skin texture detail visible - pores, subtle color variations, natural imperfections. No lens flares, no bokeh, no film grain, no post-processing filters, no stylistic effects. Raw photographic realism. ABSOLUTELY EXCLUDE: No windows, no walls, no concrete, no easels, no props, no environmental context. No borders, no frames, no grid lines between images. Not a framed artwork - a flat seamless reference sheet only. Professional figure drawing reference material for art education.
